BiblicalUsage: Mebunnai the Hushathite is named once, among David's mighty men. He is one of the warriors who stood by David through the wars with the Philistines.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the mighty men are remembered by name because loyalty has a name: Mebunnai stood with David when it cost him, and the Bible keeps the record.
